rules.statement: Only the five listed crossings (CDC-001 to CDC-005) join the CLK-MST and CLK-SLV domains; no other path exists between them.

rules.condition: Crossing of data bundles between domains
rules.statement: Each data bundle must be held stable and loaded by the destination only after its control bit arrives, so no bundle bit passes through a synchronizer.

The request bundle reg_req_payload must be held in mst, loaded at the launch edge of the request bit, and loaded into reg_apb_payload in slv at the edge that sees the request event, without a synchronizer.
The request hold register reg_req_payload and reg_apb_payload must reset to 0.
reg_req must cross to slv through N-stage synchronizer u_sync_req with no logic between the flop and the first stage, its stages reset to 0 by i_rst_n_slv.
reg_ack must cross to mst through N-stage synchronizer u_sync_ack with no logic before the first stage, reset to 0 by i_rst_n_mst.
reg_resp_hold must be held in slv, loaded at the launch edge of the acknowledge bit, and loaded into reg_resp_payload in mst at the edge that sees the acknowledge event, without a synchronizer.
reg_resp_hold and reg_resp_payload must reset to 0.
reg_wakeup, a registered copy of i_apb_pwakeup, must cross to slv through N-stage synchronizer u_sync_wk, reset to 0 by i_rst_n_slv.
The two resets are asserted together and each released synchronously to its own clock, outside the IP.

rules.condition: One domain released while the other is still in reset
rules.statement: Release of one reset while the other domain is still in reset is allowed; no request is launched or seen because the mst FSM leaves IDLE only on a Setup phase.
On i_rst_n_mst assertion (active-low, asynchronous), all mst-block state resets: registers 0, FSM IDLE, o_apb_pready and o_apb_pslverr 0.
On i_rst_n_slv assertion (active-low, asynchronous), all slv-block state resets: registers 0, FSM IDLE, including o_apb_psel, o_apb_penable and o_apb_pwakeup.
The IP must contain no reset synchronizer; both resets must arrive already synchronized.
No transfer may start before both resets are released; the requester keeps i_apb_psel low until then.
Stopped-clock, warm-reset and retention cases are not supported.
The IP has no isolation, retention or power sequencing of its own; it sits in one always-on power domain.
